checks.criterion: The Thermal Atlas dashboard loads with Ladakh branding, animated mountain backdrop, and a visible simulation controls panel
checks.name: thermal-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: THERMAL ATLAS and Ladakh subtitle, simulation-controls-panel, climate-location-select, and empty-results-state were visible.

checks.criterion: A user can select a Ladakh area preset and edit shelter inputs
checks.name: thermal-controls-edit
checks.evidence: Selected Pangong and observed -19°C night → 3°C day; changed dimensions, opening, orientation, wall/roof materials, thermal mass, and duration with updated control values.

checks.criterion: Running the thermal analysis completes the main user journey
checks.name: thermal-analysis-completes
checks.evidence: Run thermal analysis revealed metric-card-inside-now, temperature-chart-card, heat-flow-card, scenario-comparison-card, and recommendation-card.

checks.criterion: The analysis outputs are internally populated and readable
checks.name: thermal-analysis-outputs-readable
checks.evidence: All four metric values, inside/ambient legends, four heat-flow rows, 3 cases, recommendation title, and recommendation detail were non-empty/visible.

checks.criterion: A completed analysis can be saved and revisited
checks.name: thermal-saved-run-revisited
checks.evidence: Saved a unique tscheck-browser run, observed it in recent runs, clicked it, and restored metrics/chart plus the saved name.

checks.criterion: Running analysis populates the thermal API response and rejects invalid payloads
checks.name: test_tscheck_thermal_analysis.py
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/analyze returned 200 with 24 chart points, heat flows, scenarios, and recommendation; invalid dimensions returned 422.

checks.criterion: A completed analysis can be persisted and listed by the API
checks.name: test_tscheck_saved_analysis.py
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/analyses returned 200 for a unique tscheck fixture; GET /api/analyses returned 200 and contained the returned id; empty name returned 422.

checks.criterion: Backend validation and API-backed data flows work through the public preview contract
checks.name: test_tscheck_api_contract.py
checks.evidence: HTTP analyze, save, and list requests all returned 200; duration_hours=2 returned 422. Pytest suite: 6 passed.
